name: Tomato Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Fry minced garlic in olive oil until golden.
Add diced tomatoes and simmer into a thick sauce.
Combine pasta and sauce and serve hot.

name: Scrambled Eggs
steps: Whisk eggs and milk in a bowl with a pinch of salt.
Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour in eggs and gently scramble until just set.
Serve warm immediately.

name: Omelette with Cheese
description: Classic folded omelette stuffed with melted cheese.
steps: Beat eggs thoroughly with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a frying pan over medium heat.
Pour eggs into the pan and cook until set on bottom.
Sprinkle grated cheese on one half and fold over.
Cook for another minute until cheese melts.

name: Fried Rice
description: Quick, delicious fried rice with veggies and egg.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic until soft.
Push veggies to side, scramble egg in the pan.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce, stirring constantly.
Cook for 3 minutes until heated through.

name: Potato Soup
steps: Peel and chop potatoes into small cubes.
Sauté chopped onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add potatoes and water, simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in milk and mash slightly until creamy.
Season with salt and pepper before serving.

name: Garlic Butter Bread
steps: Mix softened butter with minced garlic.
Spread garlic butter generously on bread slices.
Toast in oven or pan until golden brown.
Serve warm as a snack or side dish.

name: Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, milk, egg, and melted butter in a bowl.
Heat a lightly buttered pan over medium heat.
Pour batter in small rounds onto the pan.
Flip when bubbles appear and cook until golden brown.

name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Peel potatoes and boil in salted water until tender.
Drain potatoes thoroughly.
Mash potatoes with butter and warm milk until smooth.
Season generously with salt and pepper.

name: Tomato Soup
steps: Sauté chopped onion and garlic in butter.
Add diced fresh tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add milk and blend or whisk until smooth.
Serve hot with crusty bread.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Chop onion, garlic, and tomatoes into pieces.
Heat olive oil in a pan over high heat.
Sauté garlic and onion for 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes and cook until crisp-tender.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Garlic Butter Rice
steps: Melt butter in a pan and sauté minced garlic.
Add cooked rice and toss until thoroughly coated.
Season with salt to taste and serve immediately.

name: French Toast
description: Golden toasted bread soaked in egg and milk.
steps: Whisk egg and milk in a wide bowl.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Dip bread slices in egg mixture until soaked.
Fry slices until golden brown on both sides.

name: Cheese Toastie
steps: Butter bread slices on one side.
Place cheese between unbuttered sides of bread.
Toast in skillet over medium-low heat until golden.
Flip and toast other side until cheese melts completely.

name: Potato Salad
description: Cool potato salad with eggs and onion.
steps: Boil potatoes and eggs until cooked through.
Peel and dice potatoes and hard-boiled eggs.
Finely chop onion and combine with potatoes and eggs.
Mix gently with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Chill before serving.

name: Egg Salad
steps: Hard-boil eggs in boiling water for 10 minutes.
Cool, peel, and chop eggs into small pieces.
Mix chopped eggs with finely diced onion and butter.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Garlic Butter Pasta
description: Quick pasta tossed in garlic and butter.
steps: Boil pasta until tender.
Melt butter in skillet and sauté minced garlic.
Toss pasta in garlic butter until well coated.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Egg Fried Rice
description: Classic egg fried rice with garlic and butter.
steps: Melt butter in wok and fry minced garlic.
Add eggs and scramble gently.
Add cooked rice and toss continuously until piping hot.

name: Creamy Tomato Pasta
description: Pasta in rich tomato cream sauce.
steps: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic and tomatoes in olive oil.
Stir in milk and cheese until sauce is creamy.
Combine pasta with sauce and serve.

name: Cheese & Potato Bake
description: Baked potato slices layered with cheese.
steps: Thinly slice potatoes and chop onion.
Layer potatoes, onion, and cheese in baking dish.
Pour milk over layers and dot with butter.
Bake at 190C for 40 minutes until bubbly and golden.

name: Simple Flour Biscuits
steps: Mix flour, salt, and melted butter.
Stir in milk until soft dough forms.
Drop spoonfuls onto baking sheet.
Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until lightly browned.

name: Vegetable Omelette
steps: Sauté diced tomatoes and onion in olive oil.
Whisk eggs with salt and pour over vegetables.
Cook until eggs are set and fold in half.
Serve warm.
